thread:
maya: Quick note - running an accelerated SI onboarding pilot in two weeks. Need a short 'play' that covers lab access, marketplace checklist, certification gate, and partner support hours. Who can volunteer to stitch the docs?

ryan: I can assemble the marketplace checklist and a short 10-step cheat sheet. Prefer bullet form for the play.

priya: Happy to own the cert gate design. Thinking: automated smoke + manual verification call for edge cases. Pass threshold 80%.

samir: Ill handle lab access and voucher ops. Partner confirmations: RackScale available weekdays 9-6 PT, CloudWave evenings 6-11 PT, EdgeBox tentative. Will coordinate with procurement for voucher limits.

partners-bot: Note: create calendar event "SI accelerated pilot kickoff" - Tue 09:30 PT. Event created.

maya: Key constraints: ephemeral creds only, no prod model keys, and a lightweight incident escalation path. The play should fit on a single page + one appendix.

ryan: For the cheat sheet, include: prereqs, listing steps, testing commands, rollback steps, and contact. I'll draft and post by EOD Mon.

priya: Cert flow idea: Stage 1: 15-min quiz, Stage 2: 45-min lab practical (deploy + list), Stage 3: scenario readout (10 min). Badge issued after manual QA sign-off.

samir: Operational checklist: request CIDR, set up one short-lived IAM role per partner, KMS cross-account rules, and quota ticket template. I'll attach links.

maya: Also require partner support hours for first 48 hrs of the pilot; we need phone + slack handle. I'll escalate to Partner Ops.

priya: Can we add a "common fail" doc to the play? e.g., missing ECR permissions, token expiry, incorrect model variant. Short fixes only.

ryan: Agreed. I'll add a tiny troubleshooting panel.

partners-bot: Reaction logged: :bell: event reminder scheduled.

maya: Action items: Ryan = cheat sheet + troubleshooting (Mon EOD), Priya = cert rubric + QA checklist (Tue), Samir = vouchers + ops template + partner windows (Tue EOD). We'll do a 30-min preflight on Wed.
